summary: Creating Walls Throws You Into Space

comments.content:
I have a feeling when you create a wall something weird happens, like maybe
creating it with air, but regardless, whenever you create a wall or an
unfinished wall next to space or not next to space, it throws you in
whatever direction it feels like-it makes repairing walls impossible.

Prose Eon: Bug (applies to persh's test server running now): player-created walls do
not block gas flow. Player-made rwalls, windows, rwindows, and secret doors all work
fine though. And of course, non-playermade walls work fine.
